source.title: Amendments to the Motions Approved (January 2020)
source.content:
After recent voting by WCA staff members, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved by a good majority. The Motions are effective as of January 31, 2020, and a summary of the included changes has been compiled below:
<!-- break -->
* [Motion 02.2020.1 - Definitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/02.2020.1%20-%20Definitions.pdf) - Fixed the order of the definitions to be alphabetical, add Trainee Delegate, rename Candidate Delegate to Junior Delegate.
* [Motion 06.2020.1 - Regional Organizations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/06.2020.1%20-%20Regional%20Organizations.pdf) - Added a requirement for Regional Organizations to be legally registered entities (The Board agreed to allow a grace period until December 31, 2020 and begin enforcement of this beginning January 1, 2021).
* [Motion 08.2020.1 - Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.1%20-%20Delegates.pdf) - Renamed Candidate Delegate to Junior Delegate. Clarified that competitions are now announced by the WCAT and that Junior Delegates are already Staff. Delegates have the responsibility to support Trainee Delegates. 
* [Motion 09.2020.1 - Senior Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) - Clarified that Senior Delegates appoint and support Trainee Delegates.
* [Motion 09.2020.2 - Regional Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.2%20-%20Regional%20Delegates.pdf) - Clarified that Regional Delegates support Trainee Delegates.
* [Motion 10.2020.0 - Committees and Teams](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) - Clarified that the WEAT will be led by the WCA Board.
* [Motion 10.2020.2 - WCA Competition Announcement Team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf) - Expanded to allow WCAT Leader permission to cancel WCA Competitions.
* [Motion 10.2020.3 - Quality Assurance Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.3%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf) - Clarified the role of the WQAC in advising on the promotion, demotion, and probation of Delegates.
* [Motion 15.2020.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/15.2020.1%20-%20Suspensions%20and%20other%20Sanctions.pdf) - Expanded to provide WEC with rights to take some actions as a result of investigations.

In addition to the above amendments, the following motions have been created:

* [Motion 08.2020.2 - Trainee Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.2%20-%20Trainee%20Delegates.pdf) - Creates the role of Trainee Delegate
* [Motion 10.2020.1 - Executive Assistants Team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.1%20-%20Executive%20Assistants%20Team.pdf) - Formally establishes the WCA Executive Assistants Team

translation.title: WCA 决议修订获通过（2020 年 1 月）
translation.content:
经 WCA 工作人员近期投票，决议修订提案以明显多数通过。这些决议自 2020 年 1 月 31 日起生效，主要改动如下：
<!-- break -->
* [决议 02.2020.1——定义](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/02.2020.1%20-%20Definitions.pdf) - 将定义按字母顺序排列，增加“实习代表”，将“候选代表”更名为“初级代表”。
* [决议 06.2020.1——地区组织](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/06.2020.1%20-%20Regional%20Organizations.pdf) - 增加要求：地区组织必须是依法注册的实体。（董事会同意给予截至 2020 年 12 月 31 日的宽限期，自 2021 年 1 月 1 日起执行。）
* [决议 08.2020.1——代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.1%20-%20Delegates.pdf) - 将“候选代表”更名为“初级代表”。明确比赛现由 WCAT 公布，初级代表已属于 WCA 工作人员。代表有责任为实习代表提供支持。 
* [决议 09.2020.1——高级代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) - 明确高级代表负责任命和支持实习代表。
* [决议 09.2020.2——区域代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.2%20-%20Regional%20Delegates.pdf) - 明确区域代表为实习代表提供支持。
* [决议 10.2020.0——委员会与团队](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) - 明确 WEAT 由 WCA 董事会领导。
* [决议 10.2020.2——WCA 比赛公示组](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf) - 扩大权限，允许 WCAT 负责人取消 WCA 比赛。
* [决议 10.2020.3——质量保证委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.3%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf) - 明确 WQAC 在代表晋升、降级及考察期安排方面提供建议的职责。
* [决议 15.2020.1——暂停资格及其他处分](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/15.2020.1%20-%20Suspensions%20and%20other%20Sanctions.pdf) - 扩大权限，允许 WEC 根据调查结果采取部分措施。

除上述修订外，还新增了以下决议：

* [决议 08.2020.2——实习代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.2%20-%20Trainee%20Delegates.pdf) - 设立实习代表岗位。
* [决议 10.2020.1——董事会助理团队](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.1%20-%20Executive%20Assistants%20Team.pdf) - 正式设立 WCA 董事会助理团队。
